name: Barbell Single-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand on one leg with both hands on the bar in front of your thighs.
Hinge over the standing hip and extend the free leg behind you as the bar travels down close to your shin.
Press through the standing foot and bring your hips forward to stand tall.
Switch sides after finishing this side.
tips: Keep both hip bones pointing down toward the floor rather than opening the lifted hip sideways.
Keep a slight bend in your standing knee and glide the bar straight down close to your shin.
